children: Lesha Bank, acting on behalf of a private aviation investment fund it manages, has acquired equity interests in an aviation asset-backed securities transaction with a market value of approximately $1.04 billion (QAR 3.79 billion) from an aviation lessor and global asset management firm.

The transaction comprises a portfolio of 18 aircraft leased to nine airlines across eight countries. Following completion of the acquisition, the portfolio will be managed by Lesha Aviation Capital, Lesha Bank's Dublin-based aircraft leasing entity.
(Writing by Ahmad Mousa; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Lesha Bank buys into $1.04bln aviation securities portfolio
